I think beyond the machinistic methodology of Science (which is necessary, given it's serious problem-space with the natural world)... the reductionism of Science is perhaps the most destructive. Darwin, nowhere present in any of his recorded work, did he ever intend to publish his ideas to disprove the existence or necessity of intelligent design; a creator to the cosmos. Yet today, we often see Atheists use the Faculties of Science as an Enterprise of Absolutism; "This is all there is."
